source_text: The World Health Organization (WHO) classifies all FGM types, with infibulation (Type III) carrying the highest risk profile, including immediate complications such as excessive bleeding, urinary retention, and septic shock, alongside long-term issues like chronic pelvic infections, keloid scarring, and heightened maternal mortality from obstructed labor. [3]
